attributes.title: Level 2

subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints:
❓Did you highlight the first argument in the parameter of effects.confetti.startScreenEffect

(duration, particlesPerSecond) and update it to 5 seconds?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓How do you convert seconds to milliseconds? How many seconds is 500 ms equal to?


Solution: 

The duration argument in effects.confetti.startScreenEffect(500, 100) should be changed from 500 to 5000.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, the confetti effect is too short!


Fix the bugs in the code so that the confetti effect lasts for 5 seconds on screen.

subgroups.title: Debugging Properties and Text Parameters
subgroups.introduction: Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!

validationItems.text: Argument in effects.confetti.startScreenEffect(500, 100) is changed from 500 to 5000.
validationItems.failureText: Check the parameters in the parentheses of the effects.confetti.startScreenEffect(500, 100) code.

subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓Did you add a comma , between the 2 arguments in princessSprite.sayText(text, timeOnScreen)?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓What symbol should be placed between the arguments in the princessSprite.sayText(“Happy Birthday!”5000) code?


Solution: 

, should be added between the arguments in the princessSprite.sayText(“Happy Birthday!”5000) code so that it reads: princessSprite.sayText(“Happy Birthday!”, 5000)
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, there’s an error in the code! 


Notice that the error message on the bottom says the problem is on Line 145: , was expected.

Fix the bugs in the code so that when the project starts, the sprite says “Happy Birthday!” for 5 seconds.

subgroups.name: solve 3

steps.hints: ❓Did you update the textColor or textBoxColor argument in princessSprite.sayText(“text, timeOnScreen, animated, textColor, textBoxColor)?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓Why is the text not visible when the message appears?

❓How can you change the color of the text and/or text box?


Solution: 

The text or textBoxColor argument in the princessSprite.sayText(“Happy Birthday!”, 5000, true, 3, 3) code should be changed from 3 to any other value between 1-15.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, the sprite’s message is unreadable because the text and text box are the same color! 


Fix the bugs in the code so that the sprite’s “Happy Birthday!” message appears.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 2 of Blue Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about properties and code comments. In JavaScript, you can type directly on the editor to organize your code using code comments and set different sprite properties. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 2:

badges.title: Parameter Pilot
badges.description: Use the JavaScript editor’s documentation and code completion tools when adding parameters to functions.

badges.title: Comment, Like, and Subscribe
badges.description: Add a comment to your code.

badges.title: Say What Now?
badges.description: Use the sayText function with all 5 parameters.

badges.title: Stop and Smell the Roses
badges.description: Use the pause function to temporarily stop your project from running new code.

badges.title: Effective Immediately
badges.description: Use the startScreenEffect function with 2 parameters.

badges.title: Music to My Ears
badges.description: Use the play function to play a melody.

badges.title: To Whom it May Concern
badges.description: Use the splash function to display a message on screen.

badges.title: A Speedy Recovery
badges.description: Set a sprite’s velocity property without using the setVelocity function.

badges.title: Wall of Text
badges.description: Use the showLongText function with 2 parameters.
